subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently replace the iPhone tab bar and Control hub with this unified sidebar shell as the supported root-navigation model?
rationale: The branch deliberately removes existing root-navigation behavior and establishes a new cross-idiom UX contract; source and tests can validate implementation, but only maintainers can accept that enduring product direction.

options.title: Approve the unified sidebar direction
options.body: Adopt the sidebar as the permanent iPhone/iPad root shell once the current-head state-transition checks are accepted.

options.title: Retain tab-bar navigation
options.body: Keep the existing phone tab bar and narrow this work to additive session and attention affordances instead.

options.title: Pause for a narrower navigation proposal
options.body: Defer this broad replacement until the desired phone information architecture is specified in a maintainer-owned design decision.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified sidebar direction
recommendation.body: Adopt the sidebar as the permanent iPhone/iPad root shell once the current-head state-transition checks are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related navigation-retirement direction and this implementation series.
